explanation: New src/expression-survey/sourceJson.ts is the one transport for NeuroSeq, OXT-reference and GTEx/HPA/Allen JSON: per-family file allow-list, ?v= app-version cache-bust, one session cache, forget-on-failure and one test reset (resetSourceRequests). The three loaders keep their own validation and exported signatures; referenceJson/externalJson and the three per-family reset hooks are gone. NeuroSeq memoizes gene resolution per loaded index. Catalog lists sourceJson.ts; CONTEXT.md and EXPRESSION_SURVEY.md describe the seam.
